zh: AI这轮热潮，如果有一天退下去，最后能留下什么？
en: If this AI boom fades one day, what will remain?

zh: 不是哪家公司会赢，而是今天砸进去的技术、钱和时间，最后会沉淀成什么？
en: The real question is not which company wins, but what all this technology, money, and time will leave behind.

zh: 普通人又能从里面拿走什么？
en: And what can ordinary people take from it?

zh: 这当下的AI大爆发时代，真正能穿越周期的两类资产是什么？
en: What two assets can truly outlast today’s AI boom?

zh: 我们先回头看一下互联网泡沫。
en: Let us first look back at the dot-com bubble.

zh: 2000年前后的互联网投资热潮里，大量电信公司抢着铺光纤、建网络。
en: Around 2000, telecom companies raced to lay fiber and build networks.

zh: 后来泡沫破了，一批公司退出，很多线路也暂时没人用。
en: When the bubble burst, firms exited and many lines sat unused.

zh: 美联储的一份研究提到，上世纪90年代，
en: A Federal Reserve study noted that fiber laid in the 1990s

zh: 铺下的光纤后来一度有超过九成处于闲置状态。
en: was later more than 90 percent idle at one point.

zh: 所以有了一个名字，叫“暗光纤”。
en: It earned a name: dark fiber.

zh: 但公司可以倒，估值可以掉，埋在地下的光纤不会跟着消失。
en: Companies can fail and valuations can fall, but buried fiber does not disappear.

zh: 光纤寿命很长。后来云服务、在线视频，
en: Fiber lasts a long time. Later, cloud services and online video

zh: 移动互联网对带宽的需求继续增长。
en: kept increasing demand for bandwidth.

zh: 这些已经铺好的线路，至少不用重新再挖一遍。
en: Those existing lines did not need to be dug from scratch again.

zh: 当年显得过剩的一部分建设，也就有机会被重新利用。
en: Some infrastructure that once looked excessive could be reused.

zh: 这就是一个技术周期留下的第一层东西：底层基础设施。
en: That is the first thing a technology cycle leaves behind: infrastructure.

zh: 同一时期，个人电脑也在快速进入普通人的生活和工作当中。
en: At the same time, personal computers entered ordinary life and work.

zh: 到了1997年，美国人口普查局已经把个人电脑
en: By 1997, the U.S. Census Bureau had described personal computers

zh: 称为工作、学校和家庭里的基础工具。
en: as basic tools at work, school, and home.

zh: 而埋在地下的光纤，决定数字世界能跑多少东西。
en: Underground fiber decided how much the digital world could carry.

zh: 放在桌子上的电脑，决定了普通人怎么进入这个世界。
en: The computer on the desk decided how people entered that world.

zh: 查资料、写文档、上网、使用软件，慢慢变成了日常动作。
en: Research, documents, the web, and software became daily actions.

zh: 所以互联网那一轮真正留下来的，不止是网络，还有一个大众入口，
en: The internet era left not only networks, but also a mass-market gateway

zh: 以及围绕这个入口形成的所有使用习惯。
en: and the habits formed around that gateway.

zh: 换句话说，有些泡沫破了，只剩下一地故事；
en: Some bubbles burst and leave only stories.

zh: 但有些泡沫会把估值和热度打掉，
en: Others erase valuations and hype

zh: 却把真正建成的东西和已经形成的习惯留下来。
en: while leaving what was built and the habits people formed.

zh: 那么把这套逻辑放到今天的AI上，会留下什么？
en: Apply that logic to AI today. What might remain?

zh: 第一层可能是芯片、算力中心、数据中心这些基础建设。
en: The first layer may be chips, compute centers, and data centers.

zh: 现在围绕AI的投资确实在加速。以后会不会出现过剩，
en: Investment around AI is accelerating. Whether it becomes excessive is uncertain.

zh: 现在不能说死。但已经建下来的设施和积累下来的算力能力，
en: But facilities already built and compute capacity already accumulated

zh: 不会因为某个热门名字消失就全部归零。
en: do not vanish because a popular name disappears.

zh: 之前提到过，咱们庆阳的一个算力中心，
en: We have previously discussed the compute capacity in Qingyang.

zh: 还有前段时间字节跳动46亿在咱们宁夏中卫又设立了两家新公司，
en: More recently, ByteDance-related entities set up two companies in Zhongwei, Ningxia, with 4.6 billion yuan in registered capital.

zh: 主要是绿色算力、低碳数据中心。
en: Their stated direction includes green computing and low-carbon data centers.

zh: 第二层，是大模型这个新的能力入口。
en: The second layer is the large model as a new capability gateway.

zh: 以前你要学会一个软件，记住菜单、按钮和操作步骤，才能让电脑干活。
en: Before, you had to learn menus, buttons, and steps before software could work for you.

zh: 现在写方案、整理资料、分析表格，
en: Now, for plans, research, and spreadsheets,

zh: 越来越多的时候是先把目标用一句人话讲给AI，
en: you can first state the goal to AI in plain language.

zh: 再让它拆步骤、找工具、给出初稿。
en: Then let it break down the steps, find tools, and produce a draft.

zh: 这不代表电脑和软件消失了。真正发生变化的是，人过去要先学会机器的规则，
en: Computers and software are not disappearing. The real shift is that people once learned machine rules,

zh: 现在机器开始学习怎么理解人的目标。
en: while machines are now learning to understand human goals.

zh: 所以我认为，两层资产是成立的一套观察框架。
en: That is why I see two durable layers in this cycle.

zh: 一层是算力底座，一层是大模型带来的能力入口。
en: One is the compute foundation; the other is the capability gateway created by large models.

zh: 往咱们普通人这一层想一步，是什么？
en: What does this mean for ordinary people?

zh: 算力再便宜，大模型再强，它们最后也是很多人都能用的时代公共能力。
en: Cheaper compute and stronger models will eventually become public capabilities available to many.

zh: 同一个模型大家都能打开，
en: Everyone can open the same model.

zh: 为什么有人只能得到一份通用的答案，而有人却能拿它解决真实问题？
en: Why does one person get a generic answer while another solves a real problem?

zh: 差别不只在提示词，还在你手里有没有这两样东西。
en: The difference is not only prompting. It is whether you hold two things.

zh: 第一样，我把它叫进场资格。
en: The first is what I call permission to enter the field.

zh: 一个老板愿不愿意告诉你，客户到底在哪一步走了，
en: Will a business owner tell you where customers leave,

zh: 团队为什么推不动，过去已经试过什么。
en: why the team is stuck, and what has already been tried?

zh: 一个设计师愿不愿意把还没成形的灵感、改废的版本、预算和顾虑拿出来。
en: Will a designer show unfinished ideas, rejected versions, budgets, and concerns?

zh: 这些没整理过的一手情况，公开网络里没有，模型也不可能凭空知道。
en: This unstructured first-hand context is not on the public web, and a model cannot invent it.

zh: 这个就是你真正进过现场，AI才有机会处理别人拿不到的上下文。
en: Only after entering the real field can AI process context others do not have.

zh: 第二样是验收证据。模型能生成页面、图片和方案，
en: The second is validation evidence. A model can generate pages, images, and plans,

zh: 但它不知道这个页面有没有人真用，这张图能不能交付，
en: But it does not know whether the page was used or the image was deliverable,

zh: 这个方案到底解决了谁的问题。
en: or whose real problem the plan actually solved.

zh: 你得把结果拿回现场，知道哪里失败、为什么改、
en: Take the result back to the field and learn what failed and why it changed,

zh: 谁来检查，最后哪一步才算通过。
en: who checked it, and what finally counted as passing.

zh: 这些做过、错过、改过、被确认过的过程留下来，
en: Keep the work, mistakes, revisions, and confirmations.

zh: 下次再遇到相似问题，AI调出来的才是你自己的判断，
en: Next time, AI can retrieve your own judgment,

zh: 不是网上人人都有的答案。
en: not the same answer everyone can find online.

zh: 我前一条讲过知识库。今天再往前说一步：
en: I talked about knowledge bases before. Here is the next step:

zh: 知识库只是容器。真正值得装进去的，
en: a knowledge base is only a container. What belongs inside

zh: 是你从真实现场拿到的上下文，和被现实检验过的行动证据。
en: What belongs inside is field context and action evidence tested by reality.

zh: 所以这一轮AI周期，时代可能留下两样东西：
en: This AI cycle may leave two things:

zh: 更强的算力底座，和更自然的能力入口。
en: stronger compute foundations and a more natural capability gateway.

zh: 普通人也应该给自己留下两样东西：
en: Ordinary people should also keep two things:

zh: 进入真实现场的资格，和经过真实验收的证据。
en: field access and evidence that has passed real validation.

zh: 看到这儿，我要你们自己列两张清单。
en: Now make two lists for yourself.

zh: 第一张，哪些真实场景愿意向你打开？
en: First: which real situations are willing to open up to you?

zh: 第二张，你手上哪些结果，已经被真正使用它的人验收过？
en: Second: which results in your hands were accepted by the people who actually used them?

zh: 如果两张都是空的，先别继续囤工具。
en: If both lists are empty, stop collecting more tools.

zh: 模型会换，工具会换，热度也会换。
en: Models will change, tools will change, and hype will change.

zh: 可你真正进过什么现场，做过什么、错过什么、被谁验收过，
en: But the fields you entered, what you did, what failed, and who validated it

zh: 这些才会让AI越用越像你，而不是让你越来越像所有人。
en: will make AI work more like you instead of making you look like everyone else.

zh: 关注我，我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: Follow me. I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
